## Build

### 2026-10-04 — So, some time ago i got an idea to make a radio transmitter, just because i is not an ordinary "coding" but a real, analog thing😀. so, i found somewhere FM transmitter schematic, bought  those parts

**6h**

So, some time ago i got an idea to make a radio transmitter, just because i is not an ordinary "coding" but a real, analog thing😀. so, i found somewhere FM transmitter schematic, bought  those parts which i needed and got to work. I soldered all of that (i think it took me 5 or 4 hours), but, i needed to check if it would work at all and set the right frequencies. So at this point i used AI to check and fine-tune It. so at first i checked does it worked at all by using a life-hack i found to check by using multimeter to check does it emits RF at all. Aaaand... of course it didn't worked by the first time😅. It took me some time to find the spot where i forgot to solder some contacts, and according to to my multimeter test it worked🎉. But after that i couldn't  set the right frequencies, and just left as is.
